storage.notes: Dual microSD/microSDHC/microSDXC slot (Class V10+ recommended); dual cards act as one contiguous storage region

features: AI-powered video analytics with classified object types (person, vehicle sub-types car/truck/bicycle/motorcycle/bus outdoors; person indoors)
Analytics events: objects in/enter/leave area, loitering, line crossing (objects crossing beam), object too close, direction violated, tamper detection
Teach By Example with Avigilon Control Center
Compatible with Avigilon Control Center (ACC) Enterprise Edition 7.2+
ONVIF Profile S, T, M, G compliant
FIPS 140-3 Level 3 via onboard TPM, Secure Boot (CAM-FIPS license available)
Up to 64 privacy zones, 8 per sensor, removable
Individually adjustable sensors: Tilt +7 to 96 deg, Pan +/-120 deg, Azimuth +/-180 deg
Redundant power: seamless failover between PoE and Aux
High Framerate Mode (analytics disabled): up to 60/50 fps (3-sensor, 3.0MP)
Modular design: camera module works with Pendant, Surface, or In-Ceiling mount adapters (sold separately)
Optional IR illuminator ring (850nm, 30m range) available for Surface/Pendant mounts
Certifications: UL, cUL, CE, ROHS, RCM, BIS, UKCA, NOM, KC
